title: LangGraph Chatbot — Smart Portfolio AI Assistant (Portfolio v1)
description: Upgrade the existing portfolio-v1 chat system with LangGraph.js workflow orchestration, threaded conversations with SQLite persistence, real-time SSE streaming, integrated tools (web search, calculator, stock price), and a smarter RAG pipeline — while preserving the existing tsundere personality, action tags, multi-provider fallback, and full chat UI. Inspired by tahirkorma/langgraph-chatbot.
objectives: Replace the existing linear chat flow with a LangGraph.js state graph for intelligent multi-step orchestration (intent classification → RAG retrieval → generation → tool execution loop)
Add threaded conversation persistence via SQLite so users can create, revisit, and continue multiple chat threads (matching langgraph-chatbot's SqliteSaver pattern)
Implement real-time SSE streaming so tokens appear progressively in the UI instead of waiting for the full response

Add smart tools: web search (DuckDuckGo/Tavily), calculator, stock price (Alpha Vantage) — matching langgraph-chatbot's tool set — while adding portfolio-specific tools (portfolio query, contact/booking)

Preserve and integrate with the existing: tsundere personality and system prompt, ACTION tags ([ACTION:resume], [ACTION:booking], [ACTION:email]), multi-provider fallback (Gemini → OpenAI → rule-based), existing RAG pipeline (Upstash Vector), rate limiting, and full existing chat UI (FloatingHub, ChatPanel, ChatMessage)
Update the existing ChatPanel UI to support streaming display, thread management (sidebar with CRUD), and tool call indicators
Achieve <2s time-to-first-token streaming and <5s total response time for 95% of queries
Maintain 100/100 react-doctor score, pass tsc --noEmit, ESLint, and all existing tests

architecture.overview: The existing linear POST /api/chat handler is augmented with a LangGraph.js state graph. The graph orchestrates flow: classifyIntent → retrieveContext (existing RAG) → generate (existing Gemini/OpenAI) → routeToTool (if LLM requests a tool). Threads are persisted via SQLite (better-sqlite3) with LangGraph's SqliteSaver checkpointing. The API route streams SSE events via ReadableStream. The existing ChatPanel is updated with a useChatStream SSE hook and thread management sidebar. All existing personality, action tags, and fallback logic remain intact — LangGraph wraps them in a smarter orchestration layer.

graphArchitecture.framework: @langchain/langgraph — state graph with typed state, SqliteSaver checkpointing, and .streamEvents()
graphArchitecture.integrationPoint: The existing POST /api/chat handler is refactored. Instead of calling generateWithGemini() directly, it invokes the compiled LangGraph graph. The graph nodes call the existing provider functions (generateWithGemini, generateWithOpenAI, buildSmartFallback) internally.
newDependencies: better-sqlite3 @latest — SQLite for threading + checkpoint persistence

stateSchema.messages: Annotated list of BaseMessage with add_messages reducer — carries full conversation history
stateSchema.chatDataContext: ChatDataContext — portfolio data loaded once per request (existing type)
stateSchema.ragContext: string — optional retrieved context from existing Upstash Vector RAG
stateSchema.ragChunks: RetrievedChunk[] — raw chunks for tool/fallback use
stateSchema.toolIterations: number — counter to prevent infinite tool loops (max 5)
stateSchema.systemPrompt: string — built by the existing buildSystemPrompt()

nodes.name: classifyIntent
nodes.description: Call the existing intentClassifier + questionCatalog to detect intent. Route: greeting → skip RAG, tool_call → route to tools, rag_query → retrieveContext, general → generate directly.

nodes.name: loadContext
nodes.description: Load CMS content via existing getCmsContent() + build ChatDataContext. Build system prompt via existing buildSystemPrompt(). Only runs once per thread (cached in state).

nodes.name: retrieveContext
nodes.description: Call existing retrieve() + formatContext() from retriever.ts. Store in ragContext and ragChunks state. Non-fatal if RAG fails.

nodes.name: generate
nodes.description: Invoke existing generateWithGemini() with the system prompt + RAG context. Stream tokens via callback. If Gemini fails, try generateWithOpenAI(). If both fail, call existing buildSmartFallback(). Preserve all action tag behavior.

nodes.name: executeTool
nodes.description: Run the requested tool (web_search, calculator, stock_price, portfolio_query, send_message). Return ToolMessage with result back to the graph.

nodes.name: routeToTool
nodes.description: After generate, check if response has tool_calls. If yes and toolIterations < 5, route to executeTool. Otherwise, emit final response.

edges: routeToTool → executeTool (if tool requested, increment toolIterations)
executeTool → generate (feed tool result back to LLM)
graphArchitecture.streaming: The API route calls graph.streamEvents() and pipes events to the client as SSE. Token events from the generate node are forwarded as { type: 'token', content } events. Tool call events as { type: 'tool_call', name, args }. Status events as { type: 'status', step }.

threading.description: LangGraph's SqliteSaver persists checkpoints (conversation state) per thread_id in SQLite. The existing chat API is extended with thread CRUD routes.
threading.database: better-sqlite3 with SqliteSaver (same pattern as langgraph-chatbot's SqliteSaver(conn=sqlite3.connect('chatbot.db')))

schema.checkpoints: thread_id, checkpoint_ns, checkpoint_id, checkpoint (BLOB), metadata (BLOB) — LangGraph internal
schema.threads: id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT, message_count INTEGER — custom metadata table
schema.messages: id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, thread_id TEXT, role TEXT, content TEXT, tool_calls TEXT, created_at TEXT — for quick listing without deserializing checkpoints

threading.userFlow: User clicks 'New Thread' → new thread_id generated. User sends message → POST /api/chat with threadId. User switches thread → GET /api/chat/threads/:id loads history from checkpoints. User sees thread list → GET /api/chat/threads returns all threads. Max 50 threads, oldest auto-archived.
threading.existingBehaviorPreserved: When no threadId is provided, the existing stateless mode is used (no persistence, backward compatible)

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for current information using DuckDuckGo. Same as langgraph-chatbot's DuckDuckGoSearchRun.

tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Perform arithmetic operations (add, sub, mul, div) on two numbers. Same as langgraph-chatbot's @tool calculator.

tools.name: stock_price
tools.description: Fetch latest stock price for a given symbol (e.g. AAPL, TSLA) using Alpha Vantage API. Same as langgraph-chatbot's get_stock_price tool.

tools.name: portfolio_query
tools.description: Query portfolio data by category. Returns structured data from the CMS content already loaded in context.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message or booking inquiry to Keneth. Uses the existing contact/booking modal flow.

existingPreservation.personality: The full existing system prompt from promptBuilder.ts is preserved verbatim — tsundere personality, response format rules, ACTION tags, GWA not GPA, no markdown, etc.
existingPreservation.actionTags: [ACTION:resume], [ACTION:booking], [ACTION:email] continue to be parsed and rendered by ChatMessage.tsx. New LangGraph tool calls do not conflict with action tags.
existingPreservation.multiProvider: The generate node calls existing generateWithGemini() with fallback to generateWithOpenAI() and finally buildSmartFallback(). No changes to provider logic.
existingPreservation.rag: The existing Upstash Vector RAG pipeline (chunker, embedder, indexer, retriever, vector-store) is reused by the retrieveContext node. No changes needed.
existingPreservation.rateLimiting: The existing isRateLimited() check remains as the first gate in the POST handler, before graph invocation.
existingPreservation.chatUi: FloatingHub.tsx, ChatMessage.tsx remain unchanged. ChatPanel.tsx is updated to add: SSE streaming support, thread management UI, and tool call indicators.

techStack.rag: Existing Upstash Vector pipeline (chunker.ts, embedder.ts, retriever.ts, vector-store.ts, indexer.ts)
techStack.persistence: better-sqlite3 (new) — LangGraph SqliteSaver checkpointing + thread management
techStack.streaming: Server-Sent Events via Next.js Route Handler ReadableStream + LangGraph .streamEvents()
techStack.quality: react-doctor 0.7.3 (100/100 gate), ESLint 9 flat config, Prettier

stories.title: Install LangGraph.js and SQLite dependencies
stories.description: Add @langchain/langgraph, @langchain/google-genai, @langchain/core, @langchain/community, better-sqlite3, and @types/better-sqlite3 to portfolio-v1/package.json. Run pnpm install in the portfolio-v1 directory. Create src/lib/chat/ directory structure.

stories.title: Define LangGraph state schema and graph nodes
stories.description: Create src/lib/chat/graph.ts. Define ChatState TypedDict with messages (Annotated with add_messages), threadId, chatDataContext, ragContext, ragChunks, intent, toolIterations, systemPrompt, providerAttempts. Implement all nodes: classifyIntent, loadContext, retrieveContext, generate, executeTool, routeToTool. Wire edges with conditional routing for tools. Use SqliteSaver checkpointing with better-sqlite3 connection. Export compiled graph as 'chatbot'.

stories.title: Refactor POST /api/chat to use LangGraph graph with SSE streaming
stories.description: Modify portfolio-v1/src/app/api/chat/route.ts. Keep existing: input validation, rate limiting, request ID, error handling. Replace the linear provider-call flow with: create thread if needed → invoke graph.streamEvents() → pipe events as SSE → collect final response. Write SSE transform: token events become data chunks, tool_call events become metadata, done event signals completion. Fall back to existing behavior if graph invocation fails. Maintain backward compatibility (no threadId = stateless mode).

stories.title: Build thread management API routes
stories.description: Create portfolio-v1/src/app/api/chat/threads/route.ts — GET list all threads (id, title, updatedAt, messageCount), POST create new thread. Create portfolio-v1/src/app/api/chat/threads/[id]/route.ts — GET thread messages + history, PATCH rename thread, DELETE thread and its checkpoints. Use better-sqlite3 for all operations. Handle thread-level errors gracefully.

stories.title: Build web search tool via DuckDuckGo
stories.description: Create src/lib/chat/tools/web-search.ts. Use @langchain/community DuckDuckGoSearchRun (matching langgraph-chatbot's search_tool = DuckDuckGoSearchRun(region='us-en')). Wrap as a DynamicStructuredTool with input schema { query: string }. Handle rate limits and timeouts.

stories.title: Build calculator tool (langgraph-chatbot compatible)
stories.description: Create src/lib/chat/tools/calculator.ts. Implement the exact same calculator as langgraph-chatbot: @tool with first_num, second_num, operation (add/sub/mul/div). Return { first_num, second_num, operation, result }. Handle div by zero gracefully.

stories.title: Build stock price tool (langgraph-chatbot compatible)
stories.description: Create src/lib/chat/tools/stock-price.ts. Implement the exact same get_stock_price as langgraph-chatbot: fetch from Alpha Vantage API (GLOBAL_QUOTE) using the symbol parameter. Return the JSON response. Handle API errors and rate limits. Add ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY to env vars.

stories.title: Build portfolio-specific tools
stories.description: Create src/lib/chat/tools/portfolio-query.ts — reads CMS content from state by category, returns formatted summary. Create src/lib/chat/tools/send-message.ts — triggers contact/booking flow with confirmation. Create src/lib/chat/tools/index.ts — aggregates all tools for graph binding.

stories.title: Bind tools to Gemini and wire into graph executeTool node
stories.description: Bind all tools to the Gemini model via .bindTools([...]). Wire the executeTool node to dispatch tool calls to the correct handler. Implement the conditional edge: generate → routeToTool → executeTool → generate (max 5 iterations). Handle tool errors by returning error messages to the LLM. Test each tool individually.

stories.title: Build useChatStream SSE hook
stories.description: Create portfolio-v1/src/hooks/use-chat-stream.ts. Custom hook that POSTs to /api/chat with { message, threadId }, reads SSE via fetch + ReadableStream, parses event types: token → accumulate partial text, tool_call → show tool indicator, status → update step indicator, done → finalize message. Returns { streamedText, isStreaming, toolCalls, error, threadId }. Handle connection errors and reconnection.

stories.title: Update ChatPanel to support streaming messages
stories.description: Modify portfolio-v1/src/components/ui/ChatPanel.tsx. Replace the existing sendMessage fetch() with the useChatStream hook. Display streamed text progressively (character-by-character with cursor). Show tool call indicators (spinner + tool name) during tool execution. Keep existing: welcome message, follow-up suggestions, error states, accessibility. Maintain backward compatibility with existing ChatMessage component and action tag parsing.

stories.title: Build thread management UI
stories.description: Create portfolio-v1/src/components/ui/ThreadSidebar.tsx — sidebar panel showing thread list with title, date, message count. New Thread button, delete button (with confirmation), inline rename. Create portfolio-v1/src/components/ui/ThreadToggle.tsx — button to toggle thread sidebar. Integrate into ChatPanel header area. Use jotai for thread state management. Follow Vercel Web Interface Guidelines for accessibility.

stories.title: Add thread selector to FloatingHub
stories.description: Modify portfolio-v1/src/components/ui/FloatingHub.tsx to show recent thread titles in the hub menu. Add a 'Recent Conversations' section with the 3 most recent threads. Clicking a thread opens ChatPanel with that thread loaded. Keep existing hub menu behavior intact.

stories.title: Add feature flags for new chat features
stories.description: Add IS_LANGGRAPH_ENABLED, IS_CHAT_STREAMING_ENABLED, IS_CHAT_THREADING_ENABLED to portfolio-v1/src/lib/features.ts. Gate the new graph invocation vs existing linear flow. Gate streaming UI vs existing request/response. Gate thread sidebar vs simple chat. Default: all true.

stories.title: Write unit tests for LangGraph graph, tools, and streaming
stories.description: Vitest tests for: graph.ts (state transitions, node isolation with mocked dependencies), all 5 tools (web search mock DuckDuckGo, calculator edge cases, stock price mock Alpha Vantage, portfolio query mock data, send message mock fetch), useChatStream hook (SSE parsing, error handling, reconnection), thread API routes (CRUD operations, error cases). Minimum 85% coverage on src/lib/chat/ and src/hooks/use-chat-stream.ts.

stories.title: Write integration test for the upgraded chat API
stories.description: Add tests to portfolio-v1/src/__tests__/api/chat.test.ts: SSE streaming response parsing, thread creation via API, tool call request/response cycle, backward compatibility (no threadId = stateless), feature flag gating (new vs old flow). All existing 600-line test suite must continue to pass.

stories.title: Run quality gate and fix findings
stories.description: Run from portfolio-v1: tsc --noEmit (0 errors), ESLint (0 warnings), react-doctor check (100/100, 0 findings), vitest run (all tests pass). Fix all issues. Ensure no comments in code. Verify the full chat flow works end-to-end with streaming, threading, and tools.

stories.title: Add loading, empty, error, and edge-case UI states
stories.description: Loading: typing indicator during non-streaming, skeleton for thread list, spinner for tool calls. Empty: welcome screen with suggested topics (existing). Error: inline error handling during streaming (partial message + retry), thread load failure (retry button), tool failure (show error to user). Edge cases: very long messages (truncate display), offline mode (detect and show cached welcome), rate limit (existing behavior).

stories.title: Write documentation and update AGENTS.md
stories.description: Create docs/chatbot/ with: architecture diagram (Mermaid state graph), API reference, tool catalog, env var reference, development guide. Add an 'ai-chatbot' skill to .agents/skills/ for maintenance. Update root AGENTS.md with chatbot workflows. Update docs/prd/README.md status to in-progress.

stories.title: Seed and test with representative queries
stories.description: Test 20 representative queries covering: portfolio questions ('Tell me about project X'), tool use ('What is the stock price of AAPL?', 'Calculate 15% of 340', 'Search the web for latest AI news'), follow-up threading ('Tell me more about that'), thread management (create multiple threads, switch between them, delete one), contact intent ('I want to hire Keneth'). Verify quality, latency, streaming UX, and fallback behavior.

new: ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY — API key for stock price tool (Alpha Vantage, langgraph-chatbot compatible)
existing: OPENAI_API_KEY — OpenAI API key (existing, optional multi-provider)

nonGoals: Do NOT replace the existing provider system (generateWithGemini, generateWithOpenAI, buildSmartFallback) — the graph wraps them
Do NOT change the existing system prompt, personality, or action tag behavior
Do NOT replace the existing RAG pipeline (Upstash Vector) — the graph reuses it
Do NOT add user authentication or login — the chatbot remains a public portfolio feature
Do NOT build a separate chat page — the chat stays as a slide-over panel via FloatingHub
Do NOT migrate from Tailwind v3 to v4 or from Framer Motion 11 to motion 12 as part of this PRD
Do NOT remove or modify existing FloatingHub, HubMenu, HubMenuItem, ChatMessage, or test files — only update ChatPanel and add new files
Do NOT add image generation, file upload, or multi-language support
